title: 第1196章 化形了就不能挂身上了第1195章 练成了身魂两分各走各路
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 能突破了。
醒来后的敖青感觉到了那股压制自己的元婴圆满瓶颈，终于是彻底消失了。
一同消失了，还有那十三道劫雷汇聚的能量，以及他九成的灵力。
再晚一点醒来，他大概要虚脱了。
稍微挪动一下身子，一股钻心的疼痛袭来。
“嘶……不是，郑常这小子趁我修炼揍我了？怎么这么疼？”
“你是不是傻啊？阴阳互冲、日月交光、水火平齐，全在你体内抵消了，无异于焚基毁脉，会痛不是正常的吗？有什么好大惊小怪的？”
凶敖青的声音在敖青的脑海中响起。
继郑常、敖霞之后，又一个脑袋里有别人声音的角色出现了。
敖青真是后悔一时心软又解开了凶敖青身上的几道封印，现在好了，醒来还得听另一个自己嘴臭。
“不是，你能不能好好说话？夹枪带棒的。
信不信我找道魁给你再封起来啊。”
“你只要不犯傻，我自然就不嘲笑你啊。”
凶敖青理直气壮道。
“算了，突破化神期再说吧，等能够元神分身，你自己弄个身子一旁带着，爱咋地咋地！”
“你可别傻乎乎的这时候渡劫，没见最近闹劫灾吗？你要是渡劫失败了还要连累我！”
“我真是受不了了，你能别把我当……算了。”
敖青强压怒火，默默的在心里道：就当是渡心魔劫了！
“你特么才心魔！
骂谁呢？”
好嘛，心里嘀咕都瞒不住啊！
这要是想什么……咳咳！
不能想了！
“真是可悲！”
“你别太过分啊，你能知道我想啥，我不能知道你想啥吗？今日我丢脸，明天说不定就轮到你了。
天道好轮回，苍天饶过谁。
得饶人处且饶人啊！”
“哼，你以为我是你吗？”
他俩在头脑风暴斗嘴的时候，宁夔已经感觉到敖青的气息稳定下来了，走进了洞府。
“你算是修炼完了，你这练的什么功法？跟要自绝经脉似的，我差点没忍住叫醒你。”
“咳咳，你怎么进人家洞府都不敲门的！
content_en:
A breakthrough can be made.
After waking up, Ao Qing felt that the Yuanying Consummation bottleneck that suppressed him finally disappeared completely.
Disappeared together, along with the energy gathered by the thirteen tribulation thunders and 90% of his spiritual power.
If he woke up any later, he would probably collapse.
As he moved his body a little, a heartbreaking pain hit him.
"Hiss... No, this kid Zheng Chang beat me while I was practicing? Why does it hurt so much?"
"Are you stupid? The conflict between yin and yang, the light of the sun and the moon, and the equalization of water and fire are all canceled out in your body. It is the same as burning the foundation and destroying the pulse. Isn't it normal to feel pain? What is there to make such a fuss about?"
The fierce Ao Qing's voice sounded in Ao Qing's mind.
After Zheng Chang and Ao Xia, another character with someone else's voice in his head appears.
Ao Qing really regretted his soft-heartedness and unlocked several seals on the fierce Ao Qing. Now that he is fine, he still has to listen to his other self's bad mouth when he wakes up.
"No, can you speak properly? You are armed with a gun and a stick.
Believe it or not, I'll ask Dao Kui to seal it up again for you. "
"As long as you don't act stupid, I won't laugh at you."
Fierce Ao Qing said confidently.
"Forget it, let's talk about breaking through the spirit transformation stage. When you can get the soul clone, you can make a body and take it with you. Do whatever you want!"
"Don't be so foolish as to go through the tribulation at this time. Haven't you seen the recent tribulation? If you fail to go through the tribulation, you will implicate me!"
"I really can't stand it anymore. Can you please stop treating me like...forget it."
Ao Qing suppressed his anger and said silently in his heart: Think of it as overcoming the inner demon tribulation!
"You are such a demon!
Who are you scolding? "
Well, I can’t even hide what I’m saying in my heart!
What are you thinking about... Ahem!
I can’t think about it anymore!
"How pathetic!"
"Don't go too far. You can know what I think, but can't I know what you think? Today I am embarrassed, but tomorrow it might be your turn.
Heaven's way is easy to reincarnate, no one will be spared by heaven.
If you have to be merciful, please be merciful! "
"Hmph, do you think I am you?"
While they were brainstorming and bickering, Ning Kui felt that Ao Qing's aura had stabilized and walked into the cave.
"You've finished practicing. What kind of technique are you practicing? It's like you're going to cut off your meridians. I almost couldn't help but wake you up."
"Ahem, why did you enter someone's cave without knocking on the door?
title_en: Chapter 1196: Once transformed, you can’t hang it on your body. Chapter 1195: After training, body and soul are divided into two parts and go their own ways.
